Title: Azure Container Instances (ACI) GPU support public preview

Body.Content: Azure Container Instances (ACI) allows developers to easily run containers on Azure without managing servers.  Developers can choose the VM types that they want to run their containers in.  We are excited to announce that ACI now supports GPU enabled containers, enabling developers to run intensive jobs required for machine learning.
